about: Lilac Moon, the one source of its colors. moon is Rosé Pine Moon with my own ground (base), softer text and a lilac selection; dawn is plain Rosé Pine Dawn, for the README's light mode. The wallpaper scripts and the README images read this file; `python3 palette.py --check` (part of `nix flake check`) holds WezTerm, herdr and the status line to it; noahbrauner.com reads it for its tokens.
